description: This file defines the ActorAskCacheLoader class, which implements an asynchronous cache loader that retrieves cache entries by querying an actor through Akka ask pattern, based on entity IDs and resource types. It supports multiple configuration options such as shard-based and pub-sub based mechanisms.

classes.name: ActorAskCacheLoader
classes.description: A generic, immutable cache loader that uses Akka actors to asynchronously load cache entries for entity IDs and resource types, supporting multiple configurations like shard or pub-sub based messaging.

methods.name: forShard
methods.description: Creates an instance of ActorAskCacheLoader for sharded entity regions supporting multiple resource types.

methods.name: forShard
methods.description: Creates an instance of ActorAskCacheLoader for a single resource type with a specific actor region.

methods.name: forPubSub
methods.description: Creates an instance of ActorAskCacheLoader with pub/sub mediator supporting multiple resource types.

methods.name: forPubSub
methods.description: Creates an instance of ActorAskCacheLoader with pub/sub mediator for a single resource type.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Performs asynchronous loading of cache entries by sending a message to the actor region and processing the response.

methods.name: getEntityRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the actor reference for a specific resource type from the provider.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates the command message to query the actor based on resource type and entity ID.

methods.name: transformResponse
methods.description: Transforms the actor's response into a cache entry using the response transformer map.
